primary_miss: Luis Hernandez defeated Hugo Guillon by submission in Round 2.
lessons: Preserve access-before-weapon: initial access, sustained access, and finish access are separate.
Separate being hurt from recovery after being hurt.
Add scramble conversion and counter-grappling transition features.
Increase value of credible multi-route finishing ability.
Keep durability more influential for method/duration than winner probability.
Make cardio penalties round-dependent instead of suppressing valid early-finish probability.
Increase ultra-early finish hazard only when matchup-specific evidence supports it.
